lastText: The Passage FailsThe Hue and CryNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 15A FOREIGN GENTLEMAN HUNTED THROUGH THE EAST ENDNobody has seen you in a month, and now everybody has. The newspapers have a drawing of you and the police have a description. A constable at Purfleet has seen a man go through a locked gate, and a cabman in Camden Town has seen a man with no reflection in the window of a shop. They come with torches and dogs and handbills. The old man says that you must be a very great fool, and he does not say it unkindly.
